Roman ceramic roof? tile fragments, total dimensions 82mm in length, 50mm wide and16mm thick. The two fragments do not seem to match, but may be from the same tile. They have a deep red colour and a fine fabric. They have a rectangular cross section but when viewed in profile have an S shaped curve.
